messages.subject: Detection History by Camera
parts:
Hello Juergen,

Is it possible to get detection history for individual cameras (as opposed to by station)? My cameras are on drift fence arrays (2 cameras per array) and I have several instances of one camera from the array being stolen or damaged, but the other one is still operational. Using the station for detection history gives me an "NA" for the whole station even with one camera still operational.

Thanks!

Jen Myers

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Detection History by Camera
parts:
Hi,
sounds like it should be addressed via:
camop <- cameraOperation(..., byCamera = FALSE)
detectionHistory(..., includeEffort = TRUE)

That will get rid of the NAs in occasions with incomplete effort.
See this recent thread. It was about spatialDetectionHistory, but should apply equally to detectionHistory.

The problem with detection histories by camera is that it would likely violate model assumption (independence between stations) if nearby cameras are considered different "stations".
Best,
Jürgen
